query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp3PreviewUrl IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_mp3_preview,
  SUM(CASE WHEN watermarkedMp3Url IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_watermarked_mp3,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wavUrl IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_wav
FROM tracks;
